item.tib: dmu gshen mi 'gyur gtsug phud dbang rgyal gyi rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni mtshungs med dam pa dmu gshen chen po gang de'i zhal chab bdud rtsi 'thungs ba'i tha shar (shal) ba/ mkhas grub sprul ming can gyis/ bsti gnas sku 'bum gtsug lag khang du/ yang yang bla ma'i bka' drin dran nas/ dge sbyor thun mtshams su bsdebs pa 'di yang / rang gzhan thams cad nyams len la snying rus skye ba dang / dus bzhi mnyam sbyor du grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig b+ha zhan+tu/ 'di yang bde ldan g.yung drung khang bzang du zhal bshus bgyis pa yi/ bkra shis par shog/
